label: Box K node projected from the NECESSARY_2 classical GOD_4 root
description: Assembly (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): the classical GOD_4 root projects onto the box K node of the sense fork for the same signature, Profile and world, using necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt (Iff.rfl). It gives the box K node a closure path from every derivation of STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT (including its Dei Filius, underived-individual, act-priority-at-first, pure-act-by-composition, positive-root and asymmetry routes). It closes the node only if its premise is closed; every upstream premise keeps its status. A verified non-transcription derivation of the box K node from the same 25 quarta-via inputs already exists (argument a693bf86).
